defmodule PaymentDriver.Pool do
  use GenServer

  defstruct [:connections, :pending_ops, :transaction_log]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      connections: %{},
      pending_ops: :queue.new(),
      transaction_log: %{}
    }}
  end

  def handle_call({:begin_transaction, user_id, amount}, from, state) do
    tx_id = generate_tx_id()
    entry = %{
      user_id: user_id,
      amount: amount,
      status: :pending,
      from: from,
      started_at: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    }
    new_log = Map.put(state.transaction_log, tx_id, entry)
    {:noreply, %{state | transaction_log: new_log}, {:continue, {:process_tx, tx_id}}}
  end

  def handle_call({:check_balance, user_id}, _from, state) do
    balance = fetch_balance(user_id, state)
    {:reply, {:ok, balance}, state}
  end

  def handle_continue({:process_tx, tx_id}, state) do
    case Map.get(state.transaction_log, tx_id) do
      nil -> {:noreply, state}
      entry ->
        case validate_and_execute(entry, state) do
          {:ok, new_state} ->
            GenServer.reply(entry.from, {:ok, tx_id})
            updated_log = Map.put(new_state.transaction_log, tx_id,
              %{entry | status: :committed})
            {:noreply, %{new_state | transaction_log: updated_log}}
          {:error, reason} ->
            GenServer.reply(entry.from, {:error, reason})
            updated_log = Map.put(state.transaction_log, tx_id,
              %{entry | status: :failed})
            {:noreply, %{state | transaction_log: updated_log}}
        end
    end
  end

  defp validate_and_execute(entry, state) do
    balance = fetch_balance(entry.user_id, state)
    if sufficient_funds?(balance, entry.amount, state) do
      execute_debit(entry, state)
    else
      {:error, :insufficient_funds}
    end
  end

  defp sufficient_funds?(balance, amount, state) do
    pending_total = calculate_pending_debits(state)
    balance >= amount + pending_total
  end

  defp calculate_pending_debits(state) do
    state.transaction_log
    |> Map.values()
    |> Enum.filter(fn entry -> entry.status == :pending end)
    |> Enum.map(fn entry -> entry.amount end)
    |> Enum.sum()
  end

  defp execute_debit(entry, state) do
    Task.async(fn ->
      :timer.sleep(simulate_network_latency())
      perform_db_write(entry)
    end)
    |> Task.await(5000)

    {:ok, state}
  end

  defp fetch_balance(user_id, _state) do
    case :ets.lookup(:account_balances, user_id) do
      [{^user_id, balance}] -> balance
      [] -> 0
    end
  end

  defp perform_db_write(entry) do
    [{user_id, current}] = :ets.lookup(:account_balances, entry.user_id)
    :ets.insert(:account_balances, {user_id, current - entry.amount})
    :ok
  end

  defp generate_tx_id do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.hex_encode32(case: :lower)
  end

  defp simulate_network_latency, do: Enum.random(10..50)
end

defmodule PaymentDriver.API do
  def charge(user_id, amount) when is_integer(amount) and amount > 0 do
    GenServer.call(PaymentDriver.Pool, {:begin_transaction, user_id, amount}, 10_000)
  end

  def balance(user_id) do
    GenServer.call(PaymentDriver.Pool, {:check_balance, user_id}, 5_000)
  end

  def concurrent_charges(user_id, amounts) when is_list(amounts) do
    amounts
    |> Enum.map(fn amt ->
      Task.async(fn -> charge(user_id, amt) end)
    end)
    |> Enum.map(&Task.await(&1, 15_000))
  end
end
